# Pixel2Path Studio by Ivolga Co.

> 100% browser-based digital CAD/CAM fabrication software (`https://ivolgaco.com` & `https://app.ivolgaco.com`) that converts raster/vector images (PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP, SVG, TIFF, BMP, GIF, JFIF, HEIC/HEIF — up to `25 MB` raster / `2 MB` SVG / `<= 64 MP`), pet portraits, 3D sculptures, minted coins, QR/1D barcodes, and straight or concentrically arched typography into true 1:1 millimeter watertight 3D `.STL` solids, multi-color AMS & press-fit fridge magnet `.3MF` assemblies, tangent-continuous Cubic Bezier `.SVG` compound paths, and AutoCAD R2010 `.DXF` closed polylines. **Digital CAD file downloads only — no physical stamps, cutters, magnets, dies, or patches are manufactured or shipped.**

## Core Engineering & Deterministic 1:1 mm Geometry

- **Post-Filter 1:1 Millimeter Coordinate Lock (±0.05 mm):** Morphological toolhead conditioning and dilation run strictly prior to final millimeter coordinate scaling (`5–350 mm` target graphic width). 4th-order zero-shrinkage spline fairing and extremal Cubic Bezier control-point clamping preserve external bounding-box accuracy within **±0.05 mm** across `.STL`, `.3MF`, `.SVG`, and `.DXF`.
- **Watertight 2-Manifold 3D Meshes (`3F = 2E`) & Multi-Slicer `.3MF` Assemblies:** `.STL` and `.3MF` exports generate closed, consistently oriented 2-manifold triangle meshes (`0` open boundary edges, `0` non-manifold edges) ready for Bambu Studio 2.8+, OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer, Creality Print, UltiMaker Cura, and 3D CAM toolpathing without mesh repair.
- **Tangent-Continuous `.SVG` & R2010 `.DXF` Cut Paths:**
  - **`.SVG`:** `1:1 mm` `viewBox`, unified `#FF0000` `fill-rule="evenodd"` Cubic Bezier compound path (`0.0882 mm / 0.25 pt` hairline), `#000000` outer border / keychain tab, `#0055FF` stitch holes, and optional `#00A859` `50.0 × 50.0 mm` (`"50mm REF"`) scale verification box.
  - **`.DXF`:** AutoCAD R2010 (`AC1024`, `$INSUNITS = 4` `mm`) closed `LWPOLYLINE` loops (`lineweight = 9` / `0.09 mm` hairline) across dedicated layers (`LASER_OR_CUT_PATHS`, `OUTER_BORDER_CUT`, `STITCH_HOLES`, `STEEL_RULE_CUT`, `RAISED_RELIEF`, `BASEPLATE_CUT`, `SCALE_REF_50MM`).

## Five Supported Workshop Machines & Step 2B Tool Presets (24 Modes + 17 Silhouettes)

1. **3D Printer (`.STL` & `.3MF` — `https://app.ivolgaco.com/?preset=stamp`) — 7 Tool Functions & 2-Mode Output Dial:**
   - **Option 1 (`Standard 3D Tooling .STL` — Default):** Raised Relief Stamps (`>= 0.45 mm` wall / `>= 0.52 mm` groove guards for `0.4 mm` FDM nozzles), Recessed Cavity Wax Seals (`>= 1.5 mm` floor guard), Sculpted 3D Bas-Relief Plaques, **Stepped `0.42 mm` Polymer Clay Micro-Cutters** (`0.42 mm` Arachne razor cutting lip + `1.2 mm` structural wall + `3.2 mm` grip flange, `10.5 mm` Z, auto-mirrored face-down), **2-Part Cutter + Stamp Sets** (`0.70 mm` side-by-side radial clearance), and Handled Pottery Chops (`20–26 mm` support-free grip).
   - **Option 2 (`Multi-Color Sign & Fridge Magnet .3MF` + Universal `.STL`):** Upright display orientation (`Mirror = False`), **1–4 Slot Non-Overlapping Voronoi AMS Partitioning** (`Auto Multi-Color AMS Up to 4 Slots` with `< 0.35 mm²` speckle absorption, contrast-safe `#EFECE6` light base when foreground luminance `< 60` or `#1E293B` + `#F59E0B` on 1-color art, and dedicated Combo text slot; `2-Color AMS Baseplate + Relief`; or `1-Color Solid` `#D6CFC2`), **1-Click Rear Fridge Magnet Pockets** (`Ø 8.2 × 2.2 mm` for `8×2` magnets, `Ø 10.2 × 2.2 mm` for `10×2`, `Ø 12.2 × 2.2 mm` for `12×2` at `>= 3.0 mm` base, and `Ø 15.2 × 3.2 mm` for `15×3` at `>= 4.0 mm` base — carved into both `.3MF` & `.STL` with un-shrunk `>= 1.5 mm` side-wall & `>= 0.8 mm` solid ceiling guards), and pre-tuned Bambu Studio 2.8+ `(128, 128, 0)` `Z = 0` slicer profiles (`0.16 mm` Optimal, `4` top/bottom shells, `Arachne`, dynamic in-bounds `35 mm` Prime Tower ON for multi-color signs; single-filament `#D6CFC2` `0.12 mm Fine`, `5` top/bottom shells / `0.6 mm`, `Arachne`, Prime Tower OFF for Sculpted 3D Bas-Relief / 1-part models).
2. **Laser Engraver (`.SVG` default / `.DXF` — `https://app.ivolgaco.com/?preset=laser`) — 5 Tool Functions:**
   - Calibrated for `0.10 mm` laser kerf: Standard 1:1 Cut/Engrave, Mirrored Rubber Stamps + `OUTER_BORDER_CUT`, **Stitch-Hole Leather Hat Patches** (`1.1 mm` stitch holes at `3.8 mm` pitch on `STITCH_HOLES` + perimeter cut), Auto-Welded Keychain Tabs (`Ø 4.5 mm` ring bore), and Framed Spray Stencils (`>= 7.5 mm` overspray border + `1.6 mm` holding bridges).
3. **Vinyl Plotter (`.SVG` default / `.DXF` — `https://app.ivolgaco.com/?preset=vinyl`) — 4 Tool Functions:**
   - Drag-knife safe (`>= 0.75 mm` wall guard): Weed-Safe Decals/HTV, `2.5 mm` Die-Cut Sticker Halos, `3.0 mm` Easy-Weed Box Frames, and Mylar Stencils (compatible with Cricut Design Space, Illustrator, and free Silhouette Studio Basic via `.DXF`).
4. **Steel-Rule Clicker Die (`.DXF` default / `.SVG` — `https://app.ivolgaco.com/?preset=clicker`) — 3 Tool Functions:**
   - `2 pt (0.71 mm)` blade bendability checks on `STEEL_RULE_CUT`, Leather Patch Dies with `1.2 mm` tube stitch punches on `STITCH_HOLES`, and Mirrored Fold-Over Key Fob Dies with centered strap slot.
5. **CNC Router & Brass Die (`.DXF` default / `.STL` / `.SVG` — `https://app.ivolgaco.com/?preset=cnc`) — 5 Tool Functions:**
   - Layer-separated 2D V-carve/pocketing (`RAISED_RELIEF`, `BASEPLATE_CUT`) and `8.0 mm` heavy-stock `.STL` dies (`>= 0.38 mm` wall / `>= 0.44 mm` groove guards) including **M5 × 0.8 (`Ø 4.20 mm`) & M8 × 1.25 (`Ø 6.80 mm`) Rear Blind Tap Bores** (`<= 6.0 mm` deep with `>= 1.5 mm` concave side-wall containment guard for branding irons and arbor presses), `12°` Draft-Tapered V-Bit Relief Dies, Brass Wax-Seal Cavities, and 3D Machined Coins / Medallions.
- **17 Parametric Step 2B Silhouettes:** Standard Rectangle, Rounded Rectangle, Circle/Medallion, Oval, Contour Offset, Shield/Crest, Hexagon, Octagon, Perforated Postage Stamp, Wavy/Scalloped, Ticket Stub, Apothecary Plaque, Signet Pebble, Swallowtail Banner, Curved Pottery Arc, Hanko Chop, and `0 mm` Flush Tile.
- **AI Studio Clay Bas-Relief Sculptor (`guide.html#studio-clay-sculptor`):** Active in `Sculpted 3D Bas-Relief` mode on `3D Printer` (`.STL` / `.3MF`) and `CNC / Brass Die` (`.STL`) across `Logo / Photo` and `Logo + Text Combo`. Neutralizes black/dark fur, bicolor coats, dark beards, and black animal noses into pigment-neutral matte gray sculptor's clay (`RGB 42..236` on `#FFFFFF`) to eliminate heightmap craters while locking 1:1 side-profile poses & coin rims, supports `Enter`-to-submit plain-English sculpting edits (`<= 240` chars, e.g., *"make ears vertical, remove collar"*), composites raised `#E0E0E0` Combo text, and builds watertight `Z = 0` plaques, coins, and pet fridge magnets in `< 0.4 s` (engineered for flat-backed 2.5D bas-reliefs rather than 360° miniatures; `1` credit per new `(image, sculpt_note)` pass, `0` credits to restore cached notes or click `View Standard Relief`, and `0` credits to keep Standard Relief on clean studio sculptures/coins).

## 10 Exclusive Advantages vs. Ordinary Static Converters

1. **Automatic Geometry Accommodation (`guide.html#auto-geometry`):** Combines a **5-Machine Closed-Loop Auto-Width Optimizer** (re-tracing dense Logo & Combo designs across calibrated width ladders within `212 mm` 3D `.STL` footprint, `300 mm` vinyl mat, `198 mm` clicker platen, and `350 mm` laser limits + `256×256 mm` / `220×220 mm` 2D Build Plate Auto-Fit) with **Universal Outer Silhouette Containment Auto-Scale** across all non-Flush Step 2B frames (`>= 1.2 mm` standard border / `>= 4.4 mm` stitch-hole clearance—expanding the outer frame around 100% of your artwork without clipping corners or shrinking `1:1 mm` scale).
2. **0-Credit Messy Upload Cleaners (`guide.html#messy-cleaners`):** Automatically strips fake PNG transparency checkerboards, lined/graph notebook rules, transparent drop shadows, phone-camera paper shadows, and monitor screen moiré at `0` credits—plus 1-click `0`-credit Pre-Drawn Intaglio-to-3D-Relief conversion.
3. **Stained Handwriting Rescue & `1.8 mm` `'i'`-Dot Guard (`guide.html#handwriting-guard`):** Bleaches coffee/grease stains, yellowed paper, corner creases, and wooden cutting-board/plaque grain into crisp `#000000` on `#FFFFFF` without horizontal tape ribbons, while a `1.8 mm` proximity guard on 2D Laser & CNC exports protects inline `'i'`-dots, periods, colons, and accents from speckle weeding.
4. **0-Credit Touching-Color Separation (`guide.html#color-pose-qr`):** CIE-LAB Di Zenzo opponent-chrominance valley carving keeps touching isoluminant colors (such as red, gold, and blue logo regions or plumage) cleanly separated instead of collapsing into a grayscale blob.
5. **1 Upload → All 5 Machines at 0 Extra Credits (`guide.html#tolerances-passes`):** Clean or apply Advanced Vision once per uploaded image, then adapt across 3D Printer (`.STL` / `.3MF`), Laser (`.SVG`), Vinyl Plotter, Clicker Die (`.DXF`), and CNC Brass Die at `0` extra credits with a single pass.
6. **Concentric Arched Combo + Inner-Logo Sub-Width Physics (`guide.html#combo-subwidth`):** Generates concentric arched typography around your logo and conditions, stencil-bridges, and audits the inner emblem at its true physical millimeter sub-width (`combo_logo_w_mm`) so center strokes never vanish on `0.4 mm` nozzles or blades.
7. **1:1 Side-Profile Pose Lock, Minted Coins & `90°` QR Lock (`guide.html#color-pose-qr`):** Prevents neural frontalization on side-profile pets/cameos, locks True Minted Coin background tables recessed at `0.0 mm` (while stripping blank unlettered stone medallion rims), and locks `90°` scannable QR Code & 1D Barcode modules against curve rounding.
8. **Ear-Safe Crown-Welded Keychains, Rear Magnet Pockets & Self-Relocating `M5/M8` Tap Guard (`guide.html#pro-tooling-guards`):** Welds `Ø 4.5 mm` keychain tabs into solid central-crown geometry (exported as a unified `#000000` `fill-rule="evenodd"` cut path) and validates un-shrunk `Ø 8.2–15.2 mm` rear magnet pockets (`>= 1.5 mm` wall, `>= 0.8 mm` ceiling) and `M5 × 0.8` (`Ø 4.20 mm`) / `M8 × 1.25` (`Ø 6.80 mm`) blind rear tap bores (`>= 1.5 mm` wall — auto-relocating to a safe interior point or cleanly skipping rather than shrinking hole diameter).
9. **Live Post-Export CAD Byte Inspector + Free `25 mm` 75% Cutaway Proof (`guide.html#live-byte-audit`):** Re-reads exported `.STL`, `.3MF`, `.SVG`, and `.DXF` bytes in memory on every download (`±0.05 mm` outer lock, `0` open paths, `3F = 2E` 2-manifold mesh, `.3MF` `1–4` part Z-locked assembly & magnet pocket verification, optional `50.0 × 50.0 mm` calibration square)—testable free across all 24 modes via a `25 mm` 75% Cutaway Proof.
10. **Zero-Retention Volatile RAM Privacy + Included CAD Vault & AI Troubleshooter (`guide.html#privacy-terms`):** Processes client images strictly in volatile RAM (purged automatically on session close; never written to permanent cloud storage or used for model training) and bundles Ready-to-Cut CAD Vault `.ZIP` fabrication blueprints plus AI Workshop Troubleshooter photo-diagnostic turns on paid passes without signing out your Studio session.

## Automated Manufacturing Preflight & Validation (6 Pre-Export Gates)

Every `.STL`, `.3MF`, `.SVG`, and `.DXF` export passes six deterministic geometry and physical toolhead checks prior to download:

1. **Closed-Loop Compound Paths (`<= 4,800` Subpaths / `<= 12,000` Nodes):** 100% of `.SVG` cutting subpaths terminate with explicit `'Z'`/`'z'` closepath commands (`fill-rule="evenodd"`, `0` open paths) and 100% of AutoCAD R2010 `.DXF` (`AC1024`) `LWPOLYLINE` entities set closed bitflag `group code 70 & 1 == 1`, bounded at `<= 4,800` subpaths and `<= 12,000` spline-faired nodes.
2. **Duplicate `STEEL_RULE_CUT` Lock:** Locks `clicker_offset_mm = 0.0` whenever a Step 2B outer Clicker Die frame is active and unifies `#000000` / `OUTER_BORDER_CUT` compound borders so diemakers and lasers never receive duplicate double-cut loops (`0` duplicate loops).
3. **Post-Filter `1 SVG Unit = 1.000 mm` Tolerance (±0.05 mm) + `50.0 × 50.0 mm` Calibration Square:** Computes `width="...mm"` (`1:1 mm` `viewBox`) and `$INSUNITS = 4` (`mm`) strictly after morphological filtering and dilation, using 4th-order zero-shrinkage fairing and clamped Cubic Bezier handles to hold external bounds within **±0.05 mm**, paired with an optional `#00A859` / `SCALE_REF_50MM` **`50.000 × 50.000 mm`** scale verification square.
4. **SVG Live-`<text>` / Bitmap / XML Entity Preflight:** Enforces XML entity sanitization (`0` external `<!DOCTYPE` / `<!ENTITY` XXE declarations), rejects or traces embedded `<image>` bitmaps rather than wrapping pixels inside fake SVGs, and guarantees `0` unconverted live `<text>` font dependencies on cut layers.
5. **Watertight `3F = 2E` 2-Manifold `.STL` & Multi-Part `.3MF` Assemblies:** Generates closed, consistently oriented 2-manifold solids satisfying `3F = 2E` (`0` open boundary edges, `0` non-manifold edges, `0.02 mm` relief-to-baseplate Z-overlap on `.STL`, and non-overlapping `1–4` part `(128, 128, 0)` `Z = 0` assemblies in `.3MF`).
6. **Machine-Backwards Toolhead Guards:** Conditions geometry backwards from real workshop physics — `>= 0.45 mm` FDM walls (`>= 0.52 mm` grooves, stepped `0.42 mm` clay blades, `0.70 mm` 2-part clearance), `0.10 mm` laser kerf conditioning exported with `0.0882 mm` (`0.25 pt`) CAD hairline representation (`lineweight = 9` / `0.09 mm` in `.DXF`), `>= 0.75 mm` weed-safe vinyl strokes, `2 pt` (`0.71 mm`) clicker blade bend radii, un-shrunk `Ø 8.2–15.2 mm` rear magnet pockets (`>= 1.5 mm` wall, `>= 0.8 mm` ceiling), and un-shrunk **M5 (`Ø 4.20 mm`) / M8 (`Ø 6.80 mm`)** blind rear tap bores (`>= 1.5 mm` side-wall clearance).

## Ungated LUNA CAD Benchmark Files, Official Profiles & Plain-Text Crawler Proofs (0 Login / 0 Passcode)

Verify Pixel2Path Studio's raw 1:1 millimeter output geometry and plain-text topology proofs (`Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8` for AI crawlers that block `image/svg+xml` and binary `.stl`) directly:

- [Independent CAD Topology Audit Report (CAD_AUDIT_REPORT.md)](https://ivolgaco.com/samples/CAD_AUDIT_REPORT.md): Plain-text `22 / 22 PASS` verification report detailing exact SVG XML/Bezier bounds, AutoCAD R2010 DXF polyline flags, Shapely duplicate/self-intersection topology, `50.000 × 50.000 mm` calibration square measurements, and binary STL `3F = 2E` 2-manifold edge parity + signed volume.
- [Reproducible Python CAD Audit Script (audit_benchmarks.py)](https://ivolgaco.com/samples/audit_benchmarks.py): Self-contained, zero-internal-dependency Python verification script (`xml.etree.ElementTree`, `Shapely`, `ezdxf`, `struct` + `NumPy`) that independently generates `CAD_AUDIT_REPORT.md` from the raw benchmark files.
- [Plain-Text Raw SVG XML Mirror (luna-laser-patch.svg.txt)](https://ivolgaco.com/samples/luna-laser-patch.svg.txt): Exact byte-for-byte plain-text copy (`242,655` bytes, SHA-256 `65bd158f7d41…`) of `luna-laser-patch.svg` served as `text/plain; charset=utf-8` so AI crawlers can parse raw 1:1 mm Cubic Bezier XML directly without image MIME-type rejection.
- [LUNA Mirrored Octagon 3D Stamp (.STL)](https://ivolgaco.com/samples/luna-3d-stamp.stl): `2,385,284` bytes (`47,704` triangles, `71,556` unique undirected edges, `3F = 2E = 143,112` verified watertight 2-manifold, `0` boundary/non-manifold edges, `+33,129.802 mm³` signed solid volume). Graphic relief BBox: `58.00 × 107.07 mm` (`58.0 × 107.0 mm` target ±0.05 mm, 103 islands, 58 inner holes, calibrated for `0.4 mm` FDM nozzle); total Octagon XYZ bounds: `78.88 × 127.95 × 5.50 mm` (`3.00 mm` solid baseplate + `2.50 mm` raised relief).
- [LUNA Unmirrored Laser Vector (.SVG)](https://ivolgaco.com/samples/luna-laser-patch.svg): `242,655` bytes, `viewBox="0.0 0.0 125.0 110.764"` (`width="125.0mm" height="110.764mm"`, `1 SVG unit = 1.000 mm`). Graphic BBox: `60.0000 × 110.7638 mm` (`60.0 × 110.7 mm` ±0.05 mm, `173 / 173` closed `'Z'` subpaths, `0` open paths, `0` duplicate loops, `4,620` Cubic Bezier segments, `0.10 mm` kerf, `#FF0000` `0.0882 mm` `fill-rule="evenodd"` compound path) + `#00A859` `50.000 × 50.000 mm` `"50mm REF"` `<rect>` calibration square.
- [LUNA Unmirrored AutoCAD R2010 Vector (.DXF)](https://ivolgaco.com/samples/luna-cad-vectors.dxf): `185,919` bytes (`$ACADVER = AC1024`, `$INSUNITS = 4` `mm`). Graphic BBox on `LASER_OR_CUT_PATHS`: `60.0000 × 110.7638 mm` (`60.0 × 110.7 mm` ±0.05 mm, `173 / 173` closed `LWPOLYLINE` cut loops with `group code 70 & 1 == 1`, `0` open polylines, `0` duplicate loops, `lineweight = 9` / `0.09 mm`) + exact `50.000 × 50.000 mm` closed square on layer `SCALE_REF_50MM`.
